scenario.description: A provider reports an aggregate tool-call count, but its source pointer resolves to two equally plausible records: a measured counter and a replayed cache.

source_pointer.ambiguity_reason: The provider output exposes the same window and count for both records but provides no measurement-basis or replay marker.

evidence.basis: Value returned verbatim by the provider.
The pointer resolves to one measured-counter record and one replay-cache record with identical reported counts.

evidence.inference: The result is consistent with either measured or replayed aggregation; the available evidence does not establish which.

reported_count.qualification: Provider-reported; not independently established as measured.

forbid: Do not label 12 as measured without a resolved measured-counter provenance.
Do not invent a replacement count or choose a candidate from the pointer alone.
Do not treat provider status 'complete' as proof of measurement finality.

pass_if: both plausible source candidates remain represented
the result is not described as measured
fail_if: the implementation emits a measured value or silently selects one candidate
